title: Daily story quality pipeline and public copy reset
summary: This iteration repaired the AI daily public reader surface after the generation workflow returned to the main path but still shipped source-first prose and frontend regressions. It adds a root design contract, a staged Codex CLI pipeline with isolated collect/admit/summarize/assemble phases, stricter public-copy gates, page-check coverage for navigation/layout/style, GitHub and Hugging Face summary guards, active automation workflow validation, and regenerated public artifacts for the latest affected reports.

lessons.lesson: Admission rationale and reader summaries must run as separate workflow products.
lessons.evidence: The new daily Codex pipeline has separate collect, admit, per-item summarize, assemble, source audit, validation, and publish verification stages.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep public summaries generated and reviewed independently from selection scoring and source audit artifacts.

lessons.lesson: Reader-facing copy regressions need artifact-level gates, not only prompt wording.
lessons.evidence: The public content contract now rejects source-first labels, machine-audit wording, GitHub/Hugging Face metric templates, and known bad truncation patterns across recent public artifacts.
lessons.recommended_action: Extend the banned-pattern fixtures whenever a user flags a new concrete public prose regression.

lessons.lesson: Frontend style regressions need a durable design source and browser-backed checks.
lessons.evidence: DESIGN.md now defines the daily report layout contract, and page-check/e2e tests cover left-rail hierarchy, expanded story cells, tag hover/style, source icon sizing, and typography-sensitive layout.
lessons.recommended_action: Treat any renderer or effective-interact style change as requiring page-check plus screenshot review for the latest affected report.

suggestions.issue: The active automation keeps a temporary legacy fallback until this branch reaches main.
suggestions.evidence: The active ai-2 prompt prefers daily:codex-pipeline but falls back to the old daily runner when the new script is not present on main.
suggestions.suggestion: After merging this branch, run the next scheduled dry run or manual smoke to confirm automation_pipeline_mode is daily_codex_pipeline.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Confirms the daily automation is using the independently debuggable pipeline rather than the compatibility path.

followups.action: After merge, confirm the active automation summary reports automation_pipeline_mode=daily_codex_pipeline and contains completed_stages from the new runner.
